ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
begin
 if :ctrl_block_1.REPORT_NAME is null
 THEN
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.REPORT_NAME');
 show_error('9512');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_block('names');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('parm_def');
 clear_block(no_validate);

 :system.message_level := '10';
 go_block('names');
 execute_query;
 go_block('parm_def');
 execute_query;
 go_block('NAMES');
 set_control_block_items('D');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2)
 IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK_1.REPORT_NAME' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.report_name',action);
 end if;
 if action = 'D' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_report_names',ENABLED,property_false);
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_report_names',ENABLED,property_true);
 end if;
END;
